full_page.content:
1924, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 11 Cont.
June 3 Away for 12 yrs - Home twice in 20 years. Tho's Jos Carroll now in Trinidad Col. was home for Christmas in 1912. An unhappy Xmas for family because of bitter atitude against religion. - Enrolled to-day for year.
4 Michael Fr. Fleming. Once a student, married 24 yrs. Tomorrow away from Sacraments 9 yrs. & from wife 4. July 2nd Thank God! has been to confession & Communion 3 times Asked why he went into church first time after such an absence. Answered: "I don't know."
7 Augustine F. Alianiello - druggist (30) out of work off and on, discouraged, seemingly unfortunate careless in religious matters. Enrolled for year.
Henry Gilmour - after heavy and continued drinking and sudden change goes wrong
15 Kunnigunda Bauer, 57 of 1686 Ave. A. heart-sore from side of husband and two sons Enrolls whole family - ten living & 3 de- ceased in S.M.A. - done on Feast of Holy Trinity June 1
18 Rhead Family Finished. Three youngest children of Rhead Family M
21 Brokenhearted Nurse Mary T. Nixon 17 Bryant Taunton, Mass. (4171 3rd Ave. N.Y. ) Enrolls a loved relative now a confirmed drunkard - Alice Hogan the worry - mother of one child.
26 Elivira Ongera shot through spine, discharged from Mt. Sinai as hopeless case - Enrolled To-day.
Page 12
June 27 Inclination to steal overcome. Mary Ellen Ford 15th (159 - E. 123 St. N.Y.) terribly inclined to steal nothing safe in her care or where she could reach it, enrolled.
July
3 Mrs. Mary Loren (2212 - 8th Ave.) 47, anxious because of fiberous toomer said to be eating inside her, joins S.M.A. before going for Ex-ray Examination - her sister died with cancer of bone.
3 Catherine Dooley Van Stinberg 74 Brooklyn, baptized a catholic raised by an orphan never went to sacraments Enrolled to-day per- petually.
